display.purpose: Clash Display for the interactive hero signature only; characters act as spatial objects.

headline.purpose: Clash Display for the pitch, project names, and major section statements.

title.purpose: General Sans, tracked uppercase, for section toolbars.

body.purpose: General Sans for project descriptions and supporting narrative.

label.purpose: General Sans for availability, metadata, filters, and compact controls.

mono.purpose: JetBrains Mono for contact addresses and the oversized project counter.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Low resting separation for compact translucent cards.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation paired with a small upward translation.

shadows.name: showcase-depth
shadows.purpose: Deep separation reserved for the featured project artifact.

shadows.name: active-orbit
shadows.purpose: Foreground halo around active project selection.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Default color, opacity, border, and compact transform transitions.

motion.name: spatial-standard
motion.purpose: Card lift, carousel selection, and directional motion.

motion.name: focus-settle
motion.purpose: Blur-to-sharp and scale-to-rest transitions for featured artifacts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables nonessential animation and transitions under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Theme-inverting primary action with a restrained press response.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; height:2.25rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius, .5rem); background:hsl(var(--primary)); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font:600 .875rem/1 var(--font-sans); box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12); transition:background-color .3s ease,transform .3s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)) 90%,transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:1px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Translucent secondary action with a fine boundary and backdrop blur.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; height:2.25rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius:var(--radius, .5rem); background:var(--secondary-background); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:600 .875rem/1 var(--font-sans); backdrop-filter:blur(4px); box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1); transition:background-color .3s ease,transform .3s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:hsl(var(--accent)); color:hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:1px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Navigation Capsule
components.description: Centered three-zone navigation shell for identity, availability, and utilities.
components.html: JB BOOKING NEW PROJECTS
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; width:min(38rem,calc(100% - 2rem)); padding:.5rem 1.5rem; border:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius:9999px; background:var(--secondary-background); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12); backdrop-filter:blur(4px); font-family:var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav-brand { justify-self:start; font-size:.875rem; } .ds-nav-status { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-nav-status i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#34d399); box-shadow:0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb,#34d399 45%,transparent); } .ds-nav-tools { justify-self:end; display:flex; gap:.25rem; } .ds-nav-tools button { border:0; border-radius:9999px; padding:.4rem; background:transparent; color:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-tools button:hover { background:hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-nav-tools button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Availability Badge
components.description: Bare technical status label with the system's only chromatic signal.
components.css: .ds-availability { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font:600 .6875rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:color .3s ease; } .ds-availability:hover { color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-availability:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-availability-dot { position:relative; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#34d399); box-shadow:0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb,#34d399 40%,transparent); }

components.name: Project Thumbnail
components.description: Filmstrip card that dims at rest and gains an orbit ring when selected.
components.css: .ds-project-card { position:relative; width:210px; height:128px; overflow:hidden; padding:0; border:1px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); border-radius:1rem; background:var(--secondary-background); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--foreground)),0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--foreground)) 22%,transparent); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),box-shadow .4s ease; } .ds-project-art { position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 25%,color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--foreground)) 18%,transparent),transparent 25%),linear-gradient(135deg,hsl(var(--secondary)),hsl(var(--background))); } .ds-project-card::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:35% 0 0; background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.85)); } .ds-project-card strong { position:absolute; z-index:1; inset:auto .75rem .65rem; text-align:left; font:700 .8125rem/1.2 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-project-card:hover { transform:translateY(-6px); box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.32),0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-project-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Contact Channel Card
components.description: Responsive glass card for direct contact channels.
components.css: .ds-contact-card { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem; padding:1.5rem; border:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius:1rem; background:hsla(var(--card),.9); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); text-decoration:none; backdrop-filter:blur(20px); box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.1); transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),box-shadow .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),border-color .3s ease; font-family:var(--font-sans); } .ds-contact-icon { display:grid; place-items:center; width:3rem; height:3rem; flex:0 0 auto; border-radius:.75rem; background:hsl(var(--secondary)); font-weight:700; } .ds-contact-card span:nth-child(2) { display:flex; min-width:0; flex:1; flex-direction:column; gap:.25rem; } .ds-contact-card strong { font:600 .6875rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-contact-card small { color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:500 1.0625rem/1.4 var(--font-mono); overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-contact-card b { color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); transition:transform .3s ease,color .3s ease; } .ds-contact-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); border-color:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--foreground)) 45%,transparent); box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.15); } .ds-contact-card:hover b { transform:translateX(4px); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-contact-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Carousel Arrow
components.description: Circular directional control for moving through observed work.
components.css: .ds-carousel-arrow { display:grid; place-items:center; width:2.75rem; height:2.75rem; padding:0; border:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius:50%; background:hsla(var(--card),.9); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font:400 1.1rem/1 var(--font-sans); cursor:pointer; transition:background .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,transform .3s ease; } .ds-carousel-arrow:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--foreground)) 45%,transparent); transform:scale(1.05); } .ds-carousel-arrow:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-carousel-arrow:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Section Toolbar
components.description: Instrument-panel section marker with a luminous dot and quiet divider.
components.css: .ds-section-toolbar { display:flex; align-items:center; padding-bottom:1.5rem; border-bottom:1px solid hsl(var(--border)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-section-toolbar h2 { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.7rem; margin:0; font:700 1.15rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-section-toolbar i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:hsl(var(--foreground)); box-shadow:0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--foreground)) 22%,transparent); }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio behaves like a precise, luminous observatory: a near-monochrome field provides quiet depth while selected work is brought into sharp focus through scale, light, and motion. Its spatial atmosphere comes from sparse stars, broad tonal gradients, glass-like surfaces, and controlled halos rather than saturated decoration.

The system is technical and professional without becoming generic. Strong uppercase headings and measured metadata create clarity; tactile controls, project imagery, and restrained kinetic responses provide personality. Light and dark themes invert the same neutral hierarchy instead of becoming separate identities. Avoid saturated palettes, gratuitous decoration, and multicolor neon effects.
keyCharacteristics: Reversible monochrome palette with one functional green availability signal.
Large, high-contrast type set against quiet atmospheric fields.
Translucent surfaces with fine borders and interaction-led elevation.
Spatial motion that focuses, unfolds, or settles content rather than decorating it.
Pill controls, softly rounded panels, and circular navigation actions.

rules.name: The Monochrome Field Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy from value, opacity, imagery, and depth before introducing hue.

rules.name: The One Green Signal Rule
rules.body: Green belongs to verified availability status; do not spread it across unrelated actions or decoration.

rules.name: The No Neon Rainbow Rule
rules.body: Halos may amplify the active foreground color, but they must not become multicolor spectacle.

rules.name: The Two-Volume Rule
rules.body: Use either commanding display/headline type or quiet body/label type; avoid adding intermediate decorative hierarchies.

rules.name: The Uppercase Interface Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to headings, filters, labels, and metadata, never to long-form reading copy.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Attention Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are quietly layered; stronger shadows and translation appear only on hover, focus, selection, or featured status.

rules.name: The One Deep Plane Rule
rules.body: Only the featured artifact receives showcase-level depth within a composition.

dos: Do preserve the reversible monochrome hierarchy across light and dark themes.
Do let project imagery, large type, and selected states establish focal order.
Do use one-pixel neutral borders, controlled blur, and interaction-led shadows to separate planes.
Do keep motion spatial and purposeful: unfold, focus, settle, reveal, or confirm.
Do disable nonessential motion and preserve clear focus-visible states.
donts: Don't introduce saturated palettes, gratuitous decoration, or multicolor neon effects.
Don't apply strong glow, deep shadow, and scale to every element at once.
Don't use green outside verified availability status.
Don't replace the section toolbar, nested radius hierarchy, or project-first composition with generic dashboard patterns.
Don't allow atmospheric effects to reduce text contrast, obscure project imagery, or compete with interaction.
